name: Zero Trust Identity
description: Structure documenting a verified identity (user, device, or workload) used in Zero Trust Architecture access decisions per NIST SP 800-207.

properties.name: identityId
properties.description: Unique identifier for this identity record.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Category of identity: human, service-account, workload, device, robot.

properties.name: spiffeId
properties.description: SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Document (SVID) URI for workloads.

properties.name: idProvider
properties.description: Identity provider that authenticated this principal.

properties.name: authenticationMethods
properties.description: Authentication methods used: password, totp, webauthn, hardware-token, mtls, svid, saml, oidc.

properties.name: assuranceLevel
properties.description: NIST SP 800-63 Identity Assurance Level: IAL1, IAL2, IAL3.

properties.name: authenticationAssuranceLevel
properties.description: NIST SP 800-63 Authentication Assurance Level: AAL1, AAL2, AAL3.

properties.name: device
properties.description: Device associated with this identity session.

properties.name: compliant
properties.description: Whether device meets security compliance requirements.

properties.name: platform
properties.description: Device OS: windows, macos, linux, ios, android, chromeos.

properties.name: riskScore
properties.description: Current risk score 0-100 from behavioral analytics.

properties.name: lastAuthenticated
properties.description: Timestamp of most recent successful authentication (ISO 8601).
